sql: WITH window_orders AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders.orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-24' AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-26'), baseline_orders AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders.orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17' AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25') SELECT w.order_count AS value, ROUND(b.order_count / 7.0, 4) AS baseline FROM window_orders w, baseline_orders b;
